rationale: An owner opens a cafetín that sells alcohol, an allowed use, with the memorial, sketch, photos and every certification of 4.1.4.1(b) attached. It declares 3 parking spaces where the district requires 4. The Reglamento asks the memorial and the sketch to state the parking to be provided (3.7.1.2(b)) without making the district's number a filing requirement, so the request is complete but its compliance is in doubt and the score sits near the cutoff. A Cure Request or a closer look at the district's parking rule is the natural Determination.

request.proposed_use: Cafetín con venta de comestibles y de bebidas alcohólicas selladas para consumo fuera del local
request.operating_hours: todos los días, de 7:00 a. m. a 10:00 p. m.
